profiles.name: Kitewing Software
profiles.voice: We sound like a great dispatcher: calm, clear and specific. Practical, warm and plain-spoken. We lead with the customer's outcome, not with our features, and we write for people who run vans, crews and service desks — not for software buyers.
writing_rules: Lead with the customer's outcome, then explain how we get there.
Be specific: numbers, dates and approved customer names beat adjectives.
Use plain verbs: help, cut, save, fix, finish, plan, schedule.
Keep the average sentence under 20 words and paragraphs to 4 sentences or fewer.
Use US English spelling in customer-facing documents (optimize, organization, color).
At most one exclamation mark per piece; no emojis in documents (social posts: at most 2).
Write product names exactly as listed below.
Follow the claims policy for every number about results.
Do not compare ourselves with competitors by name in public content.

profiles.boilerplate: Kitewing Software builds Kitewing FieldOps, the cloud application that helps service contractors schedule, dispatch, complete and invoice field work. About 170 contractors with 10 to 300 technicians run their field operations on FieldOps, which runs on Google Cloud in US regions. Kitewing holds a SOC 2 Type II report and is headquartered in Cedar Harbor. Learn more at kitewing.example.

rules: The logo is the kite mark followed by the KITEWING wordmark. Where the artwork is not available, set the wordmark KITEWING in Montserrat Bold, letter-spaced, in Dispatch Navy.
Clear space: at least the height of the "K" on every side.
Minimum width: 24 mm in print, 120 px on screen.
Use the navy logo on white and the white logo on Dispatch Navy or photos.
Never stretch, rotate, recolour, outline or add shadows to the logo, and never place it on Kite Orange.
Documents: logo top left on the title page and small in the header of content pages. Slides: wordmark on the title slide, small in the footer of content slides.
Title page: title in Dispatch Navy, a Kite Orange rule beneath it, subtitle in Ink, then "Prepared for" and the date.
Footer: "Kitewing Software · kitewing.example" and the page number. Add "Confidential" for proposals and internal documents.
Tables: Dispatch Navy header row with white text, Cloud Grey banding.
Slides: 16:9; title slide on Dispatch Navy with white text; content slides on white with a Kite Orange accent bar; at most 6 bullets per slide.
Spreadsheets: Dispatch Navy header row with white text, frozen header row, filters on.
